scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
scripts.reset-db: node -e "import('./server/database.js').then(m => { const db = m.default; db.pragma('foreign_keys=OFF'); db.exec('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS meeting_attendance; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS transactions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS meetings; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS agendas; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS documentations; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS members; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS settings;'); db.pragma('foreign_keys=ON'); m.initDatabase(); console.log('Database reset complete.'); })"
